reviews.text: Great professionals!

We adopted Koda thanks to a partnership between a shelter and a veterinarian. From the beginning, they've been incredibly kind and welcoming. They treated my dog ​​for leishmaniasis, and now he's perfectly healthy.

This was my first time visiting this clinic for my dog, Halley's, surgery, and the experience couldn't have been better. We chose this clinic because María had been her veterinarian before, and we've always trusted her completely. Knowing our dog was in such good hands gave us so much peace of mind.

María is an incredible veterinarian and a wonderful person. Anyone lucky enough to have her on their team has a true treasure. A heartfelt thank you to the entire team for the care and affection with which you treated Halley.
I went with Tina to get her kennel cough vaccine, and they treated us with so much love and kindness. We'll be back! ✨❤️🫶🏻 …

A couple of weeks ago, Maria helped us and everything was perfect.
When someone does their job to the best of their ability, it shows; very professional and friendly service.
My dog ​​Cala had surgery this week, and everything went perfectly. The team was amazing—professional, caring, and she's definitely in the best hands. Thank you so much!

My partner took our kitten to the vet because he wasn't pooping, and they took an x-ray. They focused solely on what was visible at first glance and didn't see that the feces were blocking his bladder. We took him to another vet, and it turned out he had a bladder obstruction, which could have ended very badly if we hadn't taken him somewhere else and he hadn't been hospitalized for several days. We certainly won't be going back.

My cat almost died because of them. They took an x-ray because he wasn't pooping, and they told me it was constipation. They prescribed a bland diet and medication, and told me to go home. Luckily, I didn't believe that diagnosis and took him to the emergency room that same night. The cat had a bladder obstruction from all the stool (it was so hard that neither medication nor a special diet would have cleared it). My cat was hospitalized for three days and was very ill. Don't trust any diagnosis they give you because they're just trying to take your money.

It's wonderful to see that there are still people who love their work and do everything they can for animals. I want to thank the entire Canesval family, but especially Sophia, for the wonderful care they gave my cat.
I would recommend this clinic a hundred times over.
Very nice and kind girls, and above all, don't worry too much about your pets.

I've taken Luna there several times and I only have words of gratitude for Paloma... Polite, kind, and loving with the animals... But above all, an incredible professional... You can tell she's passionate about her work. Thank you, Canesval!!! You're the best clinic I've ever been to!!!

My dog ​​was diagnosed with a tumor in her spleen, something she didn't have before. They told me it was most likely a malignant tumor, possibly carcinoma, which is the most aggressive type of cancer with a life expectancy of about 4 or 5 months. They charged me an exorbitant amount and referred me to Auna, saying it was best for her to see an oncology specialist since they weren't specialists in this field. Obviously, I agreed and went to Auna to have her seen by a specialist, who told me there was nothing in her spleen. The lesion was in her stomach.

This happened a year ago, and my dog ​​has been perfectly healthy ever since.

I'm very sorry to give such a negative assessment, but to make such a bad diagnosis, you have to be very sure. I'm very sorry, but I won't be going back.

**Regarding your response: I'm not referring to the report your sonographer gave me, who, as always, did an impeccable job. I'm referring to the initial diagnosis one of your veterinarians gave me, which was that she had a malignant tumor in her spleen. And it turns out I didn't have a tumor, nor was it in my spleen. That's what I mean, and that's why I was referred to Auna, wasting my time and money.
The best clinic in Valencia where you can take your pet. The staff are all incredibly attentive, caring, and truly professional. For me, it's a clinic I can completely trust.
Great professionals.
Excellent service, Paloma and her team are lovely and take great care of the animals.
I took my dog ​​in because of a mistake made by another vet, and they sorted it out perfectly. They are very kind and highly professional.

I've been taking my dog ​​there for years and they're excellent! My dog ​​is about to turn 15 and has had several health problems, and they've always been right with the diagnosis and treatment.
Plus, they're very kind!
The care my dog ​​received for his illness was incredible. The clinic is very professional and dedicated to each case. I would definitely return for any future consultations. Congratulations!

BEWARE!! This clinic ran tests on my dog ​​and the results were "critical." Then they did more tests, which supposedly indicated she had kidney failure or kidney problems. She was a dog who was otherwise in good spirits and played well. Based on these tests, they told me she needed urgent surgery and would die if she didn't have it done. I told them I would get a second opinion, and they even pressured me into buying diuretic candies for her. These caused her to urinate on herself, something she had never done before. Two years have passed, and my dog ​​is still doing well, thank God, thanks to another veterinarian who calmed my nerves by saying everything was fine. Be careful.
So far so good
Happy with the treatment towards Dodo "Dao Dao" and towards us.
They're the best!
Wonderful, every single one of them

Excellent veterinary clinic, very professional and attentive to my dog. They were very caring, explained everything clearly, and it's obvious they genuinely care about the pets' health. Clean facilities and great service. Highly recommended!

The service was adequate and everything necessary was done, although the appointment was quite quick, less than 10 minutes, which surprised me because I had arrived 15 minutes early. My dog ​​tends to get nervous at the clinic due to previous experiences, something I had mentioned before the visit, and I noticed he didn't quite adjust. Overall, the service was fine, although I've had better experiences at other clinics in Valencia.
They were always very kind, careful with our dog, and told us what was best for him.

The personal service was excellent. Thanks to the staff, we were able to diagnose what was wrong with my cat, treat it, and resolve the issue. My family and I are very grateful for everything, and our cat, Paca, is happier than ever. I recommend them 100%.
Excellent service and friendly treatment.
The girls are very attentive and give my kittens an excellent check-up.
Thank you Paloma for taking such good care of Taco, our dog, for saving his life so many times and ensuring he has an amazing quality of life. You're a fantastic team ❤️
They're great! I love them and Nala does too ❤️
The best, without a doubt!!

They are a highly professional team, and their exceptional warmth and the outstanding service they provide are truly remarkable. Their comprehensive facilities offer a wide range of services to ensure the best possible health for your furry friend. Without a doubt, taking your pet here means they're in the best hands!
Every time we go to the clinic, the service is unbeatable. Very professional yet friendly people.
Excellent service throughout. Great professionals, highly recommended.
Very professional and very kind people. Kind and caring with pets and their owners. I highly recommend them.
Excellent professionals, they've been monitoring my dog ​​for a long time, and they're incredibly caring with the animals. They're the best in the area.
Same services, different prices
I have not received good treatment from the staff who work there
The price was far above the services provided, and the attitude was unprofessional.

Hello Lucia, we're sorry to hear your experience at our clinic wasn't positive.

We'd like to understand what happened so we can improve and offer the best possible service.
If you could share more details, we would be very grateful.

This clinic only cares about money. I took my dog ​​in for deworming and they refused to sell us the treatment without first consulting the dog, just to squeeze more money out of us. I always thought they were more dedicated...

A highly professional and empathetic team, both with owners and pets. They are always attentive, guiding you through the process and providing follow-up care. A very well-equipped clinic with ample resources. Without a doubt, the best veterinary clinic!
Professional and attentive. Highly recommended. 💚🐱 …
Unbeatable
